violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. OBSERVED CFM’S CERTIFICATION EXPIRED 08/27/2025.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. EDUCATION PROVIDED. A CFM MUST BE ON SITE DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION INCLUDING DURING PREPARATION PERIOD. PLEASE OBTAIN CERTIFICATION AND EMAIL EHS ON COMPLETION WITHIN 10 DAYS.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment are not being cleaned as required: INNER SURFACES OF ICE MACHINE WITH ACCUMULATION OF BLACK SUBSTANCES.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE CLEAN AND IMPLEMENT AN APPROPRIATE CLEANING SCHEDULE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OATMEAL AT 47F IN SUPERA 2 DOOR PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED OATMEAL DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at handwashing sink: END OF COOK LINE BACK FOOD PREP AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC SUPPLIED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink: END OF 3 COMPARTMENT SINK AND BACK KITCHEN PREP AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC SUPPLIED HAND SOAP DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE. Bob O's Restaurant & Bar (Inspection Date: 07/15/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Hot Water Sanitizing Temperature Met
violations.observation: Due to improper operation of the hot water, mechanical warewashing machine, the thermolabel did not turn black, indicating that food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils are not being adequately sanitized. OBSERVED MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE REGISTERED FOR HIGH TEMPERATURE DISHWASHING MACHINE WAS 151F.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Repair the dishmachine so that a thermolabel will turn black. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to manually wash, rinse and chemically sanitize food-contact surfaces. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO SET UP 3 COMPARTMENT SINK FOR SANITIZING OF DISHES AND KITCHENWARE UNTIL DISHWASHING MACHINE HAS BEEN REPAIRED AND CAN SANITIZE AT 160F.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: COOKED OATS AT 68F IN SUPERA 2 DOOR PREP TOP; SLICED CHEESE AT 45F AND SHREDDED CHEESE AT 52F IN HOSHIZAKI 3 DOOR PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD OATS, SLICED AND SHREDDED CHEESE TRANSFERRED TO WALK IN REFRIGERATOR DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: HOSHIZAKI 3 DOOR PREP TOP AT 50F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods while it is not operating properly. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO TRANSFER TCS FOODS TO ANOTHER REFRIGERATOR DUING INSPECTION. PLEASE DO NOT STORE TCS FOODS IN UNIT UNTIL REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN FOODS AT 41F OR BELOW. EMAIL EHS ONCE UNIT HAS BEEN REPAIRED.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: SHELVING IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. EDUCATION PROVIDED. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY NEXT INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Plan & Specifications Submission - Remodeling, Change of Type, Change of Operation
violations.observation: The permit holder did not submit plans or specifications for remodeling/renovation, change in type of establishment leading to extensive menu change, and/or change in layout/equipment.
violations.corrective_action: The permit applicant needs to submit the following documents to the Health Department for review and approval: PLEASE SUBMIT AMENDMENT IN YOUR PERMIT PLUS ACCOUNT ALONG WITH REQUIRED PLANS FOR APPROVAL WITHIN 48 HOURS.
